title: Shifted embedding of a circuit list
statement: Let $m,B,L$ be natural numbers and let $D_1,\ldots,D_r$ be circuits with $m$ inputs. Embedding this list using source vertices $B,B+1,\ldots,B+m-1$ and offset $B+L$ gives the same gate list as embedding it using source vertices $0,1,\ldots,m-1$ and offset $L$, then adding $B$ to every input vertex of every gate.
hypotheses_covered: A finite list of circuits, each with $m$ inputs
